mapper.sql: select id, timestamp, open, close, high, low, volume, create_time, deleted from eth_kline_second
mapper.select: where timestamp >= #{startTime} and timestamp <= #{endTime} order by timestamp asc

SELECT e.timestamp, e.open, e.close, e.high, e.low, e.volume, e10.close AS close_10min_ago, ROUND(CAST(e.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)) - COALESCE(CAST(e10.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)), CAST(e.close AS DECIMAL(20,8))), 2) AS price_change, ROUND(IF(COALESCE(CAST(e10.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)), 0) = 0, 0, (CAST(e.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)) - CAST(e10.close AS DECIMAL(20,8))) / CAST(e10.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)) * 100), 2) AS price_change_percent FROM ( SELECT timestamp, open, close, high, low, volume FROM eth_kline_second WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) e LEFT JOIN eth_kline_second e10 ON e10.timestamp = e.timestamp - 600000000 ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC

SELECT e.timestamp, e.open, e.close, e.high, e.low, e.volume, e10.close AS close_10min_ago, ROUND(CAST(e.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)) - COALESCE(CAST(e10.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)), CAST(e.close AS DECIMAL(20,8))), 2) AS price_change, ROUND(IF(COALESCE(CAST(e10.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)), 0) = 0, 0, (CAST(e.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)) - CAST(e10.close AS DECIMAL(20,8))) / CAST(e10.close AS DECIMAL(20,8)) * 100), 2) AS price_change_percent FROM eth_kline_second e LEFT JOIN eth_kline_second e10 ON e10.timestamp = e.timestamp - 600000000 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.timestamp >= #{startTime} AND e.timestamp <= #{endTime} ORDER BY e.timestamp ASC

SELECT prev_ts, curr_ts, gap_seconds FROM ( SELECT timestamp AS prev_ts, LEAD(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS curr_ts, (LEAD(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) - timestamp) / 1000 - 1 AS gap_seconds FROM eth_kline_second WHERE deleted = 0 ) t WHERE curr_ts IS NOT NULL AND gap_seconds > 0 ORDER BY gap_seconds DESC
